items.summary: Identify and update any remaining user-facing occurrences of the old phrase "Get Leader-Giotag" (and any other outdated variants of the homepage headline) so that the application consistently shows the intended updated wording where applicable.

Update the homepage section headline in frontend/src/components/RecentReports.tsx to display exactly: "Report by clicking Photo & GPS leader image, Certificate, Complaint & Legal Notice" (and ensure no other code path can override it on the homepage).
Update the document title and social/share metadata in frontend/index.html to remove the old wording and use the updated wording consistently (update <title>, og:title, and twitter:title).
